title: TRE 2.0 (2023) · Class 11–12 Computer Science · Series A
subject: BPSC TRE PYQ
topic: Complete official question booklet of the BPSC Teacher Recruitment Exam 2.0 for Senior Secondary (Class 11–12) Computer Science, held on 15 December 2023. Part I Language (English 1–8, Hindi 9–30, qualifying), Part II General Studies (31–70) and Part III Computer Science (71–150): computer fundamentals, system software, data structures, C++, networking, security, DBMS and SQL, CPU registers, number systems and Boolean algebra.
description: All 150 questions of booklet series A exactly as printed, taken from the booklet BPSC itself published, with answers from the BPSC final answer key of 25 December 2023. Question 104 was deleted by BPSC and scores as correct whatever you mark. Every question has five options: A to C plus 'More than one of the above' and 'None of the above'. Part I is qualifying only in the real exam.

[Part II · General Studies · Q.35]
Mohan can do a bit of work in 25 days which can be completed by Sohan in 20 days. Both together labour for 5 days and afterward Mohan leaves off. How long will Sohan take to complete the remaining work?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Series A): B. In 5 days both finish 5(1/25 + 1/20) = 9/20 of the work. Sohan does the remaining 11/20 at 1/20 per day: 11 days.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.36]
If X = a² – b², Y = 30 and a + b = 15, then
options: X is lesser than Y if a = b
X is greater than Y if a > b
Y is greater than X if a = b
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Series A): D. With a + b = 15, X = (a – b)(a + b) = 15(a – b). If a = b then X = 0 < 30, so both A and C hold: more than one.

questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Series A): A. 49 = 7², so 12x + 6 = 2(3x + 12), giving 6x = 18 and x = 3.
